messages.subject: First time user. "odfWeave" error
parts:
New to R and Rattle was listed as a good data mining R platform, however i keep getting an error when trying to use rattle/ and or install the packages "odfWeave" any help would be great. 

trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/contrib/3.3/odfWeave_0.8.4.zip'
Content type 'application/zip' length 1617651 bytes (1.5 MB)
downloaded 0 bytes

Error in read.dcf(file.path(pkgname, "DESCRIPTION"), c("Package", "Type")) : 
  cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  downloaded length 0 != reported length 1617651
2: In unzip(zipname, exdir = dest) : error 1 in extracting from zip file
3: In read.dcf(file.path(pkgname, "DESCRIPTION"), c("Package", "Type")) :
  cannot open compressed file 'odfWeave/DESCRIPTION', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: First time user. "odfWeave" error
parts:
Hi Richard,

The odfWeave support has not had any attention for a few years actually. It probably needs an update or to be placed more likely wiht newer approaches to achieve the same. Sorry about that.

Regards,
Graham
